about.title: About Our Service
about.subtitle: Professional transportation designed around your journey.
about.body1: ROI Limousinen provides premium, tailored chauffeur transportation across Switzerland and neighbouring countries, built around comfort, reliability and discretion.
about.body2: Whether for a special event, a corporate function, an airport transfer or a private journey, every trip is arranged with the same attention to detail — from the moment you book to the moment you arrive.

q1.question: How do you operate?
q1.answer: We provide private chauffeur transportation with professional, licensed drivers across Switzerland and neighbouring countries. You can book online, choose your route, date and time, and pay securely — no phone call required.

q2.question: What countries do you serve?
q2.answer: We operate in Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg.

q3.question: What vehicles do you offer?
q3.answer: Our current fleet is built around the Mercedes S-Class, with additional vehicles shown here as they become available.

q4.question: How can I make a reservation?
q4.answer: Select a route or use the booking form on this website, choose your date, time and details, then confirm and pay online.

q5.question: Are your chauffeurs professionals?
q5.answer: Yes — every chauffeur is trained, experienced and licensed, and focused on your safety and comfort throughout the journey.

q6.question: Do I need an account to book?
q6.answer: No. You can book, pay and receive your confirmation entirely as a guest, with no account required.

q7.question: How do I pay?
q7.answer: Payments are processed securely online through our payment provider at the end of the booking process.

q8.question: How do I receive confirmation?
q8.answer: A confirmation is sent to your email as soon as your booking is processed.
